name: MarkMonitor AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: MarkMonitor plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: ClientSecret
ca_plugin_config.description: Client Secret for Generating Bearer Token

ca_plugin_config.name: BaseUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: Base Url for MarkMonitor API such as https://url:8443

ca_plugin_config.name: MarkMonitorCaId
ca_plugin_config.description: MarkMonitor Ca Id.  Example would be 2. In MarkMonitor Onboard UI, click edit on the Ca and look at the id in the Url.

enrollment_config.name: NumberOfDaysValid
enrollment_config.description: OPTIONAL: The number of days of validity to use when requesting certs. If not provided, default is 365.
